name: Sri Trikoteswara Swamy Temple, Kotappakonda

location.address: 42WP+R39, Kotappakonda Rd, Narasaraopeta, Andhra Pradesh 522549, India
location.precision: site-level public map reference; address is a current public map/listing reference

history.summary: Government tourism sources identify Kotappakonda as a major pilgrimage centre with the Trikoteswara Swamy temple on the hill. The hill has three prominent peaks associated in the temple tradition with Brahma, Vishnu and Rudra, and the main temple is described on Brahma Shikharam. Current government tourism sources place Kotappakonda in present-day Palnadu district; older tourism material refers to it as part of Guntur District.

name_origin.summary: The name Trikoteswara is connected in the tourism description to the three-peaked hill (Trikuta/Trikoota) and the deity of the site.

features: Main shrine associated with Brahma Shikharam
